recipes.name: The Garbage Plate inspired by The Place Beyond The Pines (sort of)
ingredients: For the Diner Style Home Fries
instructions: For the Meat Sauce
Sauté diced onions until soft. Set aside. - 1 cup diced onion
Take ground beef and place it in a hot pan and distribute meat evenly. Let sit for 5 minutes or until all meat is nice and brown. - 1 pound ground beef
Constantly stir to make sure the meat is fully cooked. Scrape the bottom to make sure none gets stuck. Continue to do this until you get crispy brown bits.
Add your tomato paste and stir around to combine. - 4 ounces tomato paste

Add your ground cloves, cinnamon, allspice, cayenne pepper, ground cumin, paprika, garlic powder, and stir over medium heat. - ¼ tsp ground cloves - ¼ tsp cinnamon - ¼ tsp allspice - ¼ tsp cayenne pepper - ¼ tsp ground cumin - ¼ tsp paprika - ¼ tsp garlic powder
Add sautéed onions back to pan.
Deglaze with ½ to 1 cup of water. Scrape bottom after adding.
Add pinches of salt and pepper to mix in then set aside. - 2 pinches salt and pepper
For the Home Fries
First, dice peeled potatoes. Set in pot and cover with cold water and add white vinegar and salt. - 3 peeled potatoes - 3 tbsp white vinegar - 3 pinches kosher salt
Bring potatoes to a boil and cook for 5 minutes.
Spread on a paper towel-lined baking sheet to let cool.
Place butter and vegetable oil into a cast iron skillet. Cook potatoes in batches to keep from undercooking. - 1 tbsp vegetable oil - 1 tbsp butter
Add potatoes and let sit for 4 minutes or until potatoes have a golden crust on one side.
Repeat until potatoes are a golden crispy brown all over.
While warm, season potatoes with kosher salt, paprika (if desired), and freshly ground pepper. - 2 pinch salt - 1 tsp paprika (if desired) - 2 pinch pepper
Toss potatoes to evenly season throughout.
For the Macaroni salad
Cook and rinse chosen pasta. - Cooked and rinsed pasta

In a mixing bowl, add cut carrots, celery, green onion, parsley, peppadew peppers, garlic powder, a pinch of salt, ground pepper, and toss together. - 1 cup cut carrots - ½ cup cut celery - ½ cup chopped green onion - 1 cup parsley - ½ cup peppadew peppers - ½ tsp garlic powder - 1 pinch kosher salt - 1 pinch freshly ground pepper
Add mayonnaise to pasta. - 2 spoonfuls mayonnaise
Add sour cream. - 1 spoonful sour cream
Add Dijon mustard to pasta. - 1 tbsp Dijon mustard
Fill half a plate with your home fries and the other half with your fresh pasta salad. Continue on to make toppings!
For the Hotdogs
Cut two hot dogs in half. Place them in a pan and place another pan on top. Cook throughly. - Hot dogs
Place hot dogs on top of the plate of home fries and macaroni salad.
Cover everything in the meat sauce you set aside earlier.
(Optional) Slather with ketchup and yellow mustard. - Ketchup - Yellow mustard
